hero.title: The Future of Living, Culture, and Leisure
hero.subtitle: Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is developing destinations that celebrate heritage and bring culture, leisure, and contemporary living together.

about.title: About JCDC
about.body: Jeddah Central Development Company (JCDC) is a Public Investment Fund (PIF) company dedicated to developing world-class destinations in Jeddah. We blend the city's cultural heritage with forward-looking urban development to enhance quality of life and create new opportunities for communities.

jcd.title: Discover Jeddah Central
jcd.body: A destination for culture, leisure, and contemporary living on the Red Sea — home to vibrant neighborhoods, signature hospitality, retail and dining, and four iconic landmarks, set along a 9.5 km shoreline with a public beach and marina.
